title.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Diesel 40 prints one H / V pair, 120 m / 360 m. LZ-60 prints conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m as separate labels.
description.zh: 柴油40把距离印成一组 120 m / 360 m。LZ-60 把输送距离 100 m 和输送高度 300 m 分成两个标题。

h1.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 40 and LZ-60 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and distance 120 m / 360 m. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Diesel 40 does not print a pipe diameter. The labels for reach are not the same shape.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油40和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、管径 100 / 125 mm。柴油40不印管径。描述距离的标题形状并不相同。

heading.en: Where Diesel 40 and LZ-60 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h; LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Dimensions: Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm; LZ-60 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油40印 26 m³/h；LZ-60印 50 m³/h。外形尺寸：柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm；LZ-60印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 40 prints cells that LZ-60 does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW; Max. outlet pressure 25 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.4 m³; Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. LZ-60 prints cells that Diesel 40 does not: Model line LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132; Engine power 6105 / 145 kW; Pumping pressure 35 MPa; Conveying distance 100 m; Delivery height 300 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油40有、LZ-60没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；最大出口压力 25 MPa；料斗容积 0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。LZ-60有、柴油40没有的行：型号行 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132；发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW；泵送压力 35 MPa；输送距离 100 m；输送高度 300 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Match a site's horizontal and vertical asks to the label style actually printed, pair or split lines. Open /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40 and /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 把现场的水平和垂直要求，对照页面实际印出的标题：一组数对，或拆开的两行。看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/，看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 print the same theoretical output as LZ-60?
question.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40印 26 m³/h。LZ-60印 50 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 print the same dimensions as LZ-60?
question.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. LZ-60 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。LZ-60印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is diesel engine power missing on LZ-60?
question.zh: 为什么LZ-60没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The LZ-60 page does not print that label. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: LZ-60这一页没有印这个标题。柴油40印的是 4108 / 66 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

question.en: Where is the model line for LZ-60 printed?

answer.en: It is printed on /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ as LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. It is not printed as that label on the Diesel 40 page.
answer.zh: 印在 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，数值为 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油40页面没有这个标题。
